verdict.rationale: Mastra is a code-first TypeScript framework whose agents and workflows run as a server or standalone endpoints with no UI, and it ships built-in deployers that automate deployment. That covers headless execution. It also scores agent runs against repeatable checks before changes reach production, which hints at CI gating, but CI integration is never explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation (e.g. running evals or agents in GitHub Actions), a documented non-interactive CLI mode, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
